newsitem.title: UK: Corporate Services buys GWL for 12 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Corporate Services buys GWL for 12 mln stg.

text.p: Contract labour supplier Corporate Services Group said on Friday it is to buy GWL Holdings for 12 million stg in a move which will expand its healthcare division.
The company said it would raise 9.1 million stg by issuing 7.2 million new ordinary shares, of which 6.7 million wil be priced at 180 pence per share.

GWL reported pre-tax profits of 0.35 million stg on turnover of 12.2 million for the year to end July 1995. It will be integrated into Corporate Services' healthcare division, and is expected to contribute significantly to its profits in 1997.

"The acqusition of GWL... will broaden both our customer base and skills base, and help to provide this division with nationwide customer support," said Corporate Services executive chairman Jeffrey Fowler in a statement.
GWL, which trades as Medacs Group, supplies doctors on term contracts, maily to the National Health Service. It operates principally from Yorkshire, Manchester and Birmingham.
